steps.name: Start
steps.description: Defend the breach point for five minutes against Void creatures
steps.dialog: The boundary between our world and the Void is usually stable, but something's stirring on the other side. Void breaches are opening faster than we can close them. I need you to hold the main breach point while I calibrate the stabilizers. Five minutes—that's all I need.

steps.name: Progress
steps.description: Defeat the Void incursion leader before it stabilizes
steps.dialog: Three minutes in, and they're getting desperate. Something big is forming on the other side—an incursion leader. If it gets through, the whole boundary collapses. Hold the line, Kade. Whatever comes through, don't let it establish a foothold.

steps.name: Complete
steps.description: Stabilizers calibrated, breach sealed, incursion prevented. You held against impossible odds, and the world is safer for it. The Void will try again—it always does—but tonight, we rest. Tonight, the boundary holds.
steps.dialog: Stabilizers calibrated, breach sealed, incursion prevented. You held against impossible odds, and the world is safer for it. The Void will try again—it always does—but tonight, we rest. Tonight, the boundary holds.

party_comments.kade: Five minutes has never felt so long. My arms are still shaking from blocking that thing's strikes.
party_comments.grit: Solid defense work. Shield held, line unbroken. That's how you stop an incursion.
party_comments.vex: Standing against the darkness, protecting the light. This is the purpose of the oath. Well done, all.

quests.name: Tainted Grounds
quests.description: Investigate the new corruption zone near the observatory

steps.name: Start
steps.description: Investigate the new corruption zone near the observatory
steps.dialog: The Void doesn't just consume—it corrupts everything it touches. I've been mapping the corruption zones, and there's a new one spreading near the old observatory. If we don't cleanse it now, it'll become another Nexus. You'll need Void-resistant gear and a strong stomach.

steps.name: Progress
steps.description: Destroy the Void crystal at the corruption focal point
steps.dialog: Corruption is worse than I thought—living shadows manifesting, reality distorting. I've located the focal point: a shard of pure Void crystal feeding the spread. Destroy it, but be careful. Those things have... effects on the mind.

steps.name: Complete
steps.description: Crystal destroyed, corruption receding. The ground will need time to heal, but the immediate threat is gone. You're stronger than you look, Kade. Most who face raw Void corruption either break or become part of it. You stood firm. That's rare.
steps.dialog: Crystal destroyed, corruption receding. The ground will need time to heal, but the immediate threat is gone. You're stronger than you look, Kade. Most who face raw Void corruption either break or become part of it. You stood firm. That's rare.

party_comments.kade: That crystal was singing. Not with sound—with thoughts. Terrible thoughts. Glad it's dust.
party_comments.sova: Void corruption follows predictable patterns, yet each manifestation is unique. Fascinating and horrifying in equal measure.
party_comments.vex: The shadows reached for my soul. My oath protects me, but others... I understand now why you fear this place.

quests.name: Chamber of Echoes
quests.description: Enter the Echo Chamber and decode the cultist messages

steps.name: Start
steps.description: Enter the Echo Chamber and decode the cultist messages
steps.dialog: There's a place where the Void folds back on itself, creating an Echo Chamber. Every sound, every thought, every scream ever uttered in the Void gets trapped there, replaying forever. Someone's been using it to send messages—coded signals to Void cultists across Orion. We need to know what they're planning.

steps.name: Progress
steps.description: Return with the intelligence and prepare countermeasures
steps.dialog: Messages decoded, and it's worse than we feared. The cultists are coordinating a mass ritual—simultaneous sacrifices at twelve locations to tear open a permanent Void gate. We have the locations, but not much time. The ritual starts at the next eclipse.

steps.name: Complete
steps.description: Intelligence delivered, countermeasures deployed, catastrophe averted. Twelve teams moved on your information, disrupting the ritual before it could begin. The Echo Chamber is sealed, its secrets revealed. You've saved thousands of lives today, Kade. Again.
steps.dialog: Intelligence delivered, countermeasures deployed, catastrophe averted. Twelve teams moved on your information, disrupting the ritual before it could begin. The Echo Chamber is sealed, its secrets revealed. You've saved thousands of lives today, Kade. Again.

party_comments.kade: Hearing every scream ever uttered in the Void... that's going to haunt my dreams for a while.
party_comments.sova: The coordination required for such a ritual is impressive. The cultists are more organized than we suspected. Troubling.
party_comments.nix7: Audio decryption complete. Cultist communication patterns identified. Recommend ongoing surveillance of known operative frequencies.

quests.name: Voices from the Dark
quests.description: Find and commune with the Void entity 'Echo'

steps.name: Start
steps.description: Find and commune with the Void entity 'Echo'
steps.dialog: Not everything in the Void is hostile. Some entities... remember. They were something else before—people, places, ideas. There's one that calls itself 'Echo' near the twisted grove. It wants to talk. To you specifically. It knows things about the Progenitor Engine.

steps.name: Progress
steps.description: Perform the communion ritual and exchange a memory for knowledge
steps.dialog: Echo speaks in riddles, but there's truth buried in the madness. It wants something in exchange for its knowledge—a memory, a moment of joy, something to remind it of what it was. The communion ritual requires vulnerability. Open your mind, but keep your will strong.

steps.name: Complete
steps.description: You gave Echo a memory of sunlight, and it gave you the location of the Engine's failsafe—something even the Triumvirate doesn't know. The Void takes, but it also gives. Today, you proved that communication is possible. Maybe, just maybe, not all Void entities need to be destroyed.
steps.dialog: You gave Echo a memory of sunlight, and it gave you the location of the Engine's failsafe—something even the Triumvirate doesn't know. The Void takes, but it also gives. Today, you proved that communication is possible. Maybe, just maybe, not all Void entities need to be destroyed.

party_comments.kade: I gave it the memory of my first sunrise in Rusthaven. Felt like losing something, but... maybe it needed it more.
party_comments.petra: Communing with Void entities? That's how I ended up... like this. Be careful, Kade. The Void always takes more than it gives.
party_comments.sova: Echo was likely a researcher who got too close to the Shadow Foundation. The transformation preserves knowledge but destroys coherence. Tragic.

quests.name: The Vanished Company
quests.description: Track the lost Dominion expedition into the Void

steps.name: Start
steps.description: Track the lost Dominion expedition into the Void
steps.dialog: Twelve explorers entered the Void three months ago. Dominion-funded, best equipment, experienced team. Not a word since. Their families deserve closure, and their logs might contain valuable data. Find the expedition, recover what you can, learn their fate.

steps.name: Progress
steps.description: Follow the expedition trail to its end
steps.dialog: Found their camp—abandoned, supplies intact, no signs of struggle. It's like they just... walked away. Following their trail leads deeper than anyone's mapped. They were chasing something. Something that didn't want to be found.

steps.name: Complete
steps.description: Found them. All twelve, frozen in a moment, suspended between existing and not. The Void claimed them not through violence, but through fascination. They reached too deep, saw too much. Their logs are recovered, their families will know. Another warning etched into the darkness.
steps.dialog: Found them. All twelve, frozen in a moment, suspended between existing and not. The Void claimed them not through violence, but through fascination. They reached too deep, saw too much. Their logs are recovered, their families will know. Another warning etched into the darkness.

party_comments.kade: Frozen between moments. Not dead, not alive. That's worse than any monster I've seen.
party_comments.suresh: The medical readings... their hearts still beat, once every few minutes. They might be recoverable, with the right technology.
party_comments.korr: Dominion lost good people here. People I might have trained. The Void doesn't care about uniforms or allegiance—it takes all equally.

quests.name: Lost Memories
quests.description: Collect scattered memory fragments from three Void locations

steps.name: Start
steps.description: Collect scattered memory fragments from three Void locations
steps.dialog: The Void doesn't just destroy—it preserves, in its own twisted way. Memories, moments, fragments of lives consumed. We seek our past, twin to twin, but the Void has scattered our history across its domain. Help us reclaim our memories from the Void's embrace.

steps.name: Progress
steps.description: Defeat the memory parasite and reclaim the final fragment
steps.dialog: Two memories recovered, but the third is guarded. Something has taken root in it—an entity feeding on the memory's emotional resonance. We must defeat it to free the memory, or our past remains forever trapped.

steps.name: Complete
steps.description: All memories restored. We remember who we were, who we are, why we fight the Void's spread. You have given us back ourselves—a gift beyond price. The Void takes, but today, we took back. Balance, however small, has been restored.
steps.dialog: All memories restored. We remember who we were, who we are, why we fight the Void's spread. You have given us back ourselves—a gift beyond price. The Void takes, but today, we took back. Balance, however small, has been restored.

party_comments.kade: Seeing someone else's memories... that's intimate. Felt like I knew them better than I know myself.
party_comments.nix7: Memory storage in crystalline format. Fascinating data preservation method. Comparable to my own backup systems.
party_comments.petra: Memories are all we really are. Take them, and we're nothing. Give them back, and we're whole. Beautiful work.

quests.name: Stitching the World
quests.description: Locate and reactivate the three failing Reality Anchors

steps.name: Start
steps.description: Locate and reactivate the three failing Reality Anchors
steps.dialog: Reality is fraying at the edges. I've found three places where the Void seeps through—thin spots where existence itself is unraveling. The Progenitors left Reality Anchors to stabilize these points, but they're failing. Reactivate them, before the tears become permanent.

steps.name: Progress
steps.description: Investigate the sabotage and repair the final anchor
steps.dialog: Two anchors stabilized, but the third... it's been tampered with. Someone deliberately corrupted the alignment. This is sabotage, not decay. We need to find who did this and stop them before they damage more anchors.

steps.name: Complete
steps.description: All anchors restored, reality stabilized. The saboteur was a Void cultist—someone who thinks the Void's consumption is 'natural evolution.' We stopped them, but there are more like them. The battle for reality itself continues, one anchor at a time.
steps.dialog: All anchors restored, reality stabilized. The saboteur was a Void cultist—someone who thinks the Void's consumption is 'natural evolution.' We stopped them, but there are more like them. The battle for reality itself continues, one anchor at a time.

party_comments.kade: Reality anchors? Progenitor tech holding the world together? That's bigger than anything I signed up for.
party_comments.nix7: Reality stabilization protocols confirmed. These anchors are Lattice infrastructure—critical for planetary integrity.
party_comments.sova: Void cultists believe in 'beautiful oblivion.' They're not evil, just... wrong. Tragically, terminally wrong.

quests.name: The Mind's Labyrinth
quests.description: Enter the Mind's Labyrinth and face your inner trials

steps.name: Start
steps.description: Enter the Mind's Labyrinth and face your inner trials
steps.dialog: The Void tests more than flesh—it tests mind and soul. There's a place where reality folds inward, creating a labyrinth of pure thought. Those who enter face their deepest fears, their greatest regrets. Survive, and you'll understand the Void's true nature. Fail, and you'll join the lost ones.

steps.name: Progress
steps.description: Reach the center of the labyrinth and defeat your shadow reflection
steps.dialog: You're deeper than anyone has gone before. The labyrinth shows you truths you hid from yourself—failures, losses, the price of heroism. Most would break here. But you're still standing. Find the center. Face the reflection. Complete the trial.

steps.name: Complete
steps.description: You faced yourself and didn't flinch. The labyrinth recognizes your strength, offers its secrets. The Void isn't just destruction—it's transformation, potential, the space between moments. You understand now. That's rare. That's dangerous. That's powerful.
steps.dialog: You faced yourself and didn't flinch. The labyrinth recognizes your strength, offers its secrets. The Void isn't just destruction—it's transformation, potential, the space between moments. You understand now. That's rare. That's dangerous. That's powerful.

party_comments.kade: I saw... everyone I couldn't save. Every failure. But I also saw why I keep fighting. That's what matters.
party_comments.twist: My labyrinth was full of closed doors and locked chests. And behind every one, someone I betrayed. Not my favorite experience.
party_comments.callum: The drake within me has its own labyrinth—ancestral memories, ancient regrets. Facing that was... illuminating.

quests.name: Hunting the Shadow
quests.description: Investigate the hunter attacks and track the creature

steps.name: Start
steps.description: Investigate the hunter attacks and track the creature
steps.dialog: Something's stalking the Void-touched travelers. Not a monster—something smarter, something that learns. I've seen the bodies: drained, hollow, marked with symbols that hurt to look at. It's hunting, and we're the prey. Turn the tables. Hunt the hunter.

steps.name: Progress
steps.description: Confront and defeat the Void hunter in the Shattered Cathedral
steps.dialog: Tracks lead to the Shattered Cathedral—a place where the Void first broke through centuries ago. The hunter has made its lair there, surrounded by trophies of its kills. It's aware of you now. The hunt has become a duel. Only one predator leaves alive.

steps.name: Complete
steps.description: The hunter is dead, its lair burned, its trophies released. The Shattered Cathedral is a little less haunted tonight. You proved that even in the deepest dark, the hunter can become the hunted. Travelers will sleep safer because of what you did.
steps.dialog: The hunter is dead, its lair burned, its trophies released. The Shattered Cathedral is a little less haunted tonight. You proved that even in the deepest dark, the hunter can become the hunted. Travelers will sleep safer because of what you did.

party_comments.kade: That thing was fast. Smart. Almost got me twice. Good hunt—worthwhile prey.
party_comments.ashka: Tracking in the Void is like tracking through a nightmare. The rules keep changing. Impressive work, Kade.
party_comments.vex: A predator that preys on the innocent. There's a special place in the dark for such creatures. We sent it there.

quests.name: Heart of Darkness
quests.description: Locate the Voidheart in the deepest Void zone

steps.name: Start
steps.description: Locate the Voidheart in the deepest Void zone
steps.dialog: Deep in the Void lies a Voidheart—a crystallized essence of pure nothing. Dangerous, unstable, but incredibly valuable to those who study the Void. A scholar in Meridian Junction will pay a fortune for a sample. Get in, extract the heart, get out before you become part of the nothing.

steps.name: Progress
steps.description: Disrupt the Void elementals and extract the Voidheart
steps.dialog: Voidheart located, but it's not alone. Void elementals have gathered around it, feeding on its power. Standard combat won't work—they just reform. We need to disrupt their connection to the heart first, then strike while they're vulnerable.

steps.name: Complete
steps.description: Voidheart extracted, elementals dispersed, and most importantly—you're still you. Most who touch Void essence come back... changed. But you? You look the same. Sound the same. Hopefully, you are the same. The scholar pays well for intact specimens, and this is very intact.
steps.dialog: Voidheart extracted, elementals dispersed, and most importantly—you're still you. Most who touch Void essence come back... changed. But you? You look the same. Sound the same. Hopefully, you are the same. The scholar pays well for intact specimens, and this is very intact.

party_comments.kade: Touching that thing felt like grabbing absolute zero with my bare hands. Still can't feel my fingertips properly.
party_comments.renna: Voidheart energy readings are off every chart I have. This needs to be studied—carefully, behind very thick shields.
party_comments.sova: Pure Void essence is theoretically impossible to contain. Yet here we are. The Progenitors understood things we haven't even begun to imagine.
